fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Drives a bolt of wind into the first enemy it meets for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Stamping Ground
fusions.desc: Comes down on every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage, stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: All-Day Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pastured Roost
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
